10A.
An Ordinance amending and adding sections to the Encinitas Municipal Code relating to Non- Serialized, Unfinished Firearm Frames or Receivers and Non-Serialized Firearms. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Campbell
1) Introduce Ordinance No. 2022-08, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Chapter 9.30 Firearms to Add Sections 9.30.030 and 9.30.040 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Non-Serialized, Unfinished Firearm Frames or Receivers and Non-Serialized Firearms."
2022-06-08 Item 10A Ghost Gun Ordinance Introduction
10B.
Consider confirming the appointment of Robert Prendergast to the Planning Commission-Olivenhain Representative to fill the unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2023. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Appoint Robert Prendergast to the Planning Commission-Olivenhain Representative to fill the unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2023; and 2) Direct staff to bring back an ordinance to amend the Municipal Code to clarify and allow sitting commissioners to apply for other commission vacancies and, if appointed, the commissioner would be automatically removed from their prior commission appointment in keeping with the Council's desire to prevent dual membership.

Public Hearing to reconsider Randy Goodson's appeal of the Planning Commission denial of a Design Review Permit and Density Bonus Permit and consider an amended Design Review Permit and Density Bonus application for the demolition of existing single-family homes and accessory structures and construction of a 250-unit apartment development (200 market rate and 50 affordable units), including a leasing and amenity space, private outdoor recreation space, signage, and grading, storm water, and landscaping improvements. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-005356-2022 & DR-005366-2022; APPLICANT AND APPELLANT: Encinitas Boulevard Apartments 6.95, LP, Randy Goodson; LOCATION: 2220, 2228 & 2230 Encinitas Boulevard (APNs: 259-231-28, 30, 31 & 32). Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
Move to reconsider Randy Goodson's appeal, hold a public hearing, and adopt attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2022-70 (Attachment 01 of the agenda report) to grant the appeal and to approve the amended Design Review Permit and Density Bonus requests.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
